properties.displayName: UAV S17 - SAR Target Coordinate Exfiltration (Outside Authorized Area)
properties.description: UAVSarPayload_CL의 TargetLat/TargetLon이 UAVC4I_CL의 허가구역(AreaLat/AreaLon/AreaRadius_km) 외부인 경우 또는 단시간 프레임 버스트 탐지. MITRE: T1020 Automated Exfiltration
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 15m;
let AuthArea = UAVC4I_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, AreaLat, AreaLon, AreaRadius_km) by MissionId;
UAVSarPayload_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| join kind=leftouter (AuthArea) on MissionId
| extend distKm = geo_distance_2points(
    toreal(TargetLon), toreal(TargetLat),
    toreal(AreaLon), toreal(AreaLat)) / 1000.0
| extend isOutsideArea = isnotnull(AreaLat) and distKm > toreal(AreaRadius_km)
| summarize FrameCount=count(), OutsideCount=countif(isOutsideArea),
    MaxSizeBytes=max(SizeBytes), MaxDistKm=max(distKm)
    by UAVId, MissionId, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where OutsideCount > 0 or FrameCount > 100
| extend TriggerReason = case(
    OutsideCount > 0, strcat("SAR_허가구역_외_표적좌표_", tostring(OutsideCount), "건_최대거리_", tostring(round(MaxDistKm, 1)), "km"),
    "SAR_프레임_버스트_" + tostring(FrameCount) + "건/5min")
| extend Severity = "High"
| project TimeGenerated, UAVId, MissionId, FrameCount, OutsideCount, MaxDistKm, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S17 - SAR Target Coordinate Exfiltration (Outside Authorized Area) - {{UAVId}}
